title: Budget and Revenue
text:
Film Budgets and Worldwide Revenue
This page explores the relationship between production budgets and worldwide box-office revenues. As shown in Figure 1, the scatter plot helps us examine whether films with larger budgets tend to generate higher revenues.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.scatter(films["budget_musd"], films["revenue_musd"])

plt.xlabel("Production Budget (Million USD)")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("Film Budget vs. Worldwide Revenue")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()







Figure 1: Production budget versus worldwide box-office revenue

title: Home
text:
This website explores a dataset of 104 well-known films released between 1980 and 2025. The dataset includes production budgets, worldwide box-office revenues, film runtimes, IMDb ratings, and franchise information.
Through three analysis pages, we examine the relationship between production budgets and revenues, investigate how film runtime relates to IMDb ratings, and explore box-office performance across James Bond films.

title: Runtime and Ratings
text:
This page examines whether film runtime is related to IMDb ratings. As shown in Figure 1, the scatter plot compares the length of each film with its IMDb rating.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])

plt.xlabel("Runtime (Minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb Rating (0-10)")
plt.title("Film Runtime vs. IMDb Rating")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()







Figure 1: Relationship between film runtime and IMDb rating







The following table displays the mean IMDb rating for films released in each decade.

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10

decade_ratings = (
    films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"]
    .mean()
    .round(2)
)

decade_ratings.to_frame(name="Mean IMDb Rating")

title: The Bond Films
text:
This page examines how worldwide box-office revenue has changed across the James Bond franchise.

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")

The James Bond films in this dataset span from 1995 to 2021.


The following figure illustrates how James Bond box-office revenue has changed across release years.

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

plt.plot(
    bond["year"],
    bond["revenue_musd"],
    marker="o"
)

plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Worldwide Revenue Over Time")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()







Figure 1: Worldwide box-office revenue of James Bond films over time
